scope: Only selected application ownership changes. Other events are not migrated. An active application for new email in same event causes 409 DUPLICATE_APPLICATION, never merge/overwrite.
manualCheck: InvestigateEmailInput.data requires identityChecked:true, identityCheckMethod (1-80 non-whitespace characters), identityCheckResult:confirmed. Store method/result only, never proof images or unnecessary identity details. Server records verified actor and timestamp, never browser supplied actor/role.
operatorRead: GET /api/lt/v1/operator/applications/:id/email-change returns EmailChangeStatus (current request or null), lt.emailChange only. Every read/action revalidates current admission and admin/executive role. Assistant is 403.
response: EmailChangeRequest now requires applicationVersion, verificationExpiresAt and verifiedAt (nullable UTC instants). Final confirmation returns updated applicationVersion; UI reloads authoritative application rather than displaying an old receipt's owner.
versions: expectedVersion is current application version; expectedRequestVersion is request version. Both plus operationId remain required for send/confirm. UI keeps same operationId for transport-uncertain retries, rejects duplicate clicks and requires reload after409. Server atomically rechecks both versions, parent state, retention, current request and uniqueness. Replay must not revert a newer owner.
publicVerification: GET /auth/email-change is non-consuming. POST /api/lt/v1/auth/email-change/verify accepts only token, returns EmailAccepted accepted:true with no session creation/Set-Cookie. Origin/CSRF mandatory. purpose=email_change, one-hour token bound to fixed request/application/newEmail; resend invalidates previous unused links.
finalConfirmation: Require verified new email and explicit separate admin/executive confirmation. Ownership update, old-address session and unused login-link invalidation, audit and fake outbox must be atomic. Existing ownership of other applications is unchanged; old address must reauthenticate to access remaining applications.
activation: All added routes remain productionEnabled:false. No real mail or existing user changes. Local test adapters only.
proposalDifference: API proposal mentioned identityChecked:true; this follow-up specifies additional identityCheckMethod and identityCheckResult fields. Added operator status GET, required response applicationVersion/expiry/verified timestamp, and distinct public verification input DTO. API owner/public UI owner should consume this contract commit before connecting implementations.
